# TwisterTools

> 100% free, fast, privacy-first, browser-native online utilities and tools.

TwisterTools is a developer-centric collection of 60+ online utilities and converters designed to execute entirely in the user's browser memory (RAM). By utilizing browser-side technologies like client-side JavaScript, WebAssembly, and native browser APIs (such as the Canvas API and Web Cryptography API), TwisterTools offers zero-latency operations without transmitting any user files, inputs, codes, or secrets to external servers.

## Core Value Proposition

- **100% Privacy & Security**: No databases tracking inputs, no server logs, and no external transmission of user data. Your sensitive files and information never leave your local machine.
- **Zero Server Uploads**: PDF documents, images, formatting strings, and passwords are compiled, compressed, and converted entirely in browser RAM.
- **Instant Client-Side Computation**: Execution speeds are bound only by the user's local hardware resources, removing the lag of network queueing and remote processing.
- **Always Free, No Registration**: Every single tool in all categories is fully accessible without subscriptions, time-limited trials, paywalls, or registrations.

## Category Hubs

### [Developer, Code & Web Engineering Tools](https://www.twistertools.com/tools/developer-tools)
Essential browser-based engineering utilities for tokenizing, formatting, minifying, validating, and converting code.
- **JSON Formatter, Validator & Viewer**: Validate, beautify, compact, and inspect JSON structures.
- **XML Formatter, Validator & Viewer**: Pretty-print, minify, and validate XML documents.
- **SQL Formatter & Query Beautifier**: Format and clean SQL queries with MySQL, PostgreSQL, Standard SQL, and T-SQL dialect support.
- **CSS/JS/HTML Formatters & Minifiers**: Lexical tokenization engines to shrink or format stylesheets, scripts, and markup.
- **Base64 / URL / HTML Entity Encoder & Decoder**: Symmetrical data encoders and decoders.
- **Diff Checker**: Symmetrical text comparison tool featuring unified/split views.
- **Regex Tester & Cheat Sheet**: Debug regular expressions in real-time with visual capturing groups.
- **Unix Timestamp Converter**: Bi-directional epoch-to-date translations with a live ticker.
- **Cron Expression Explainer**: Translate complex cron configurations into human-readable text.
- **Color Picker & Contrast Checker (WCAG)**: Real-time WCAG 2.1 AA/AAA compliance checker, color space converter, and color blindness simulator.
- [CSS Box Shadow & Glow Generator](/tools/developer-tools/css-box-shadow-generator): Multi-layer CSS box shadow, inset depth, and neon glow generator with Tailwind output.
- [CSS Gradient Generator](/tools/developer-tools/css-gradient-generator): Interactive generator for linear, radial, and conic gradients with code export.
- CSS Border Radius & Clip-Path Generator: Visual 8-point organic blob generator, corner radius customizer, and CSS polygon clip-path generator with Tailwind export (/tools/developer-tools/css-border-radius-generator)
- CSS Flexbox Layout Sandbox (/tools/developer-tools/css-flexbox-playground): Interactive visual CSS Flexbox sandbox with AST CSS and Tailwind generator.
- [CSS Grid Generator](/tools/developer-tools/css-grid-generator): Visual 2D CSS grid layout builder and CSS/HTML/Tailwind code exporter.
* [CSS Triangle & Polygon Generator](/tools/developer-tools/css-triangle-generator): Interactive zero-pixel border triangles and GPU-accelerated CSS clip-path polygon generator with Tailwind and SCSS support.
- HTML Table Code Generator (/tools/developer-tools/html-table-generator): Visual responsive HTML table builder with Tailwind CSS, React TSX, Markdown, and CSV import.
- HTACCESS Generator: /tools/developer-tools/htaccess-generator - Production Apache server configuration and mod_rewrite generator.
- [Robots.txt Generator & Validator](/tools/developer-tools/robots-txt-generator): Visual RFC 9309 robots.txt builder, AI crawler blocking presets, and real-time path testing engine.
* User-Agent String Parser & Inspector: /tools/developer-tools/user-agent-parser (Inspect HTTP headers, decode browsers, operating systems, devices, and AI crawlers)
- Screen Resolution Calculator (/tools/developer-tools/screen-resolution-calculator): Calculate screen resolutions, aspect ratios, proportional scaling dimensions, and PPI display density with CSS/Tailwind exports.
- Pixels to REM / EM Converter: /tools/developer-tools/px-to-rem-converter - Bidirectional PX to REM/EM conversion utility and batch CSS processor.
- Keycode & Keyboard Event Inspector (/tools/developer-tools/javascript-keycode-finder): Real-time JavaScript keyboard event inspector tracking event.key, event.code, modifier flags, and code generators.
- Chmod Permissions Calculator (/tools/developer-tools/chmod-calculator): Linux and Unix file permissions calculator with octal, symbolic (rwx), binary conversions, and special bit modifiers.

- **PDF Extractors**: Convert PDF structures back to Word documents, plain text, Markdown, or extract raster assets.
- **PDF Split & Merge**: Combine multiple documents or slice and extract specific pages.
- **PDF Grayscale & Watermark**: Convert pages to black-and-white or stamp text/image watermarks.
- **PDF Lock & Unlock**: Encrypt PDF documents with passwords or decrypt password protections.
- **PDF Page Numbers & Stampers**: Add running headers, footers, margins, and rotate/crop orientations.
